primary_source_mapping: GitHub supports boot-persistent Linux runner operation through the runner-provided systemd service lifecycle (svc.sh install/start/status).
GitHub scheduler eligibility requires an online idle runner matching all requested labels/groups; the current labels are self-hosted + Linux + X64.
GitHub exposes repository self-hosted runner status/busy/labels through the REST API, but listing repository runners requires repository admin access / fine-grained Administration(read).

The current WP510 workflow declares contents:write only; adding a control-plane runner-roster preflight inside that workflow would require a different credential/permission surface and would still not solve the circular fact that a self-hosted job cannot run a pre-assignment check on itself.

architecture_delta.problem: WP510 target-runtime evidence is currently gated by self-hosted runner assignment, while the workflow's evidence logic begins only after assignment. Scheduler/runner availability can therefore block the experiment before the product source executes.
preferred_minimal_mechanism: Keep scheduler/runner readiness outside F2 canonical product truth and outside WP510 runtime credit.
If the target runner is intended to be persistent, operate the GitHub runner as a host service and preserve a bounded host-local service/listener liveness receipt before a singleton dispatch.

Treat GitHub-side runner online/busy/labels as separate optional control-plane evidence when an already-authorized admin read surface exists; do not add a high-privilege PAT/App secret solely to make this preflight green.
Preserve the existing singleton/no-duplicate dispatch law. A readiness witness may block a dispatch but may never mint execution, target-environment, semantic GWT or completion credit.
For Ubuntu/Debian targets using needrestart, fence the documented runner-service restart interaction so package maintenance cannot silently kill the listener during a job.
rejected_overbuild: Do not add a second truth store for runner status.
Do not treat svc.sh status, REST online status, queue assignment or job creation as product execution evidence.
Do not widen repository credentials merely to query runner status unless a later owner/security decision explicitly justifies that surface.
architecture_delta.expected_benefit: Reduce avoidable WP510 transport-only failures and distinguish host-listener readiness from scheduler assignment and from actual target-runtime execution, without changing product semantics.
architecture_delta.counterhypothesis: The runner is intentionally ephemeral/manual and persistent service operation is undesirable. If so, service installation would be the wrong mechanism; preserve only the evidence-stage split and provide an explicit manual readiness gate.
architecture_delta.falsifier: Inspect the actual target runner lifecycle/configuration. If the runner is intentionally ephemeral or an existing boot-persistent listener with verified liveness already exists, retire the service-install portion of this delta. If a persistent runner is intended and service/listener liveness is absent, the delta remains a viable build candidate.

next_exact_action: Obtain non-mutating evidence of the target runner lifecycle (persistent service vs intentional ephemeral/manual listener) from an authorized host/controller surface. If persistent is intended and liveness is absent, create a narrow E5 build candidate for a runner-readiness bootstrap/receipt. Otherwise retain only the scheduler-vs-runtime evidence split.
